Key tool:
https://embeddednerd.com/tools/esp32-touchscreen-selector/

ESP32 Board & Display Selector:
A free hardware compatibility selector for ESP32 boards and display modules. Users can filter by MCU family, display size, resolution, display interface, touch, PSRAM, GPIO, LVGL, USB and other hardware requirements.
